description: Bike Count Sites is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Main Roads Western Australia. The location of bike count sites in the Perth, Metropolitan Area. This layer provides the volumes for the latest count year.Bike volumes are collected on a continuous basis at permanent sites on principal shared paths. The Integrated Road Information System (IRIS) Reporting Centre provides a number of other reports. Coverage: Main Roads Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Main Roads Western Australia. Its tags are open data, traffic, traffic_mrwa. It offers 8 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
